item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I'm of two minds about this.

I really dig the underlying notion, actually. And this is one of those rare cases where I think we can reverse the script and say a J might work better as a main-lister. Especially if you're just going to go ahead and bring pataphysics into this and destroy that 4th wall.

In general, as a -J, this kind of overstays its welcome. While I found myself smirking, I didn't really actually feel "jokey" until the leg cramp at the end.

I know it's tough to do much with this feedback, but it's my thoughts none-the-less. Consider restructuring this into a mainlister!
